title: Kernel discipline: key_export_public outlen not bounded before copy_to_user
description: In crypto2dev_fd_read() KEY fd path, key_export_public() returns outlen into a u32. The code checks count < outlen (user buffer too small) but never checks outlen <= CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN (the size of kbuf). A provider that misbehaves or is corrupted and returns outlen > CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN will cause copy_to_user(ubuf, kbuf, outlen) to read past the end of the CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN-sized kbuf allocation, producing a kernel heap over-read. Fix: add if (outlen > CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN) check after the callback returns.
close_reason: fixed: added outlen > CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN check with pr_err and -EOVERFLOW before copy_to_user in crypto2dev_fd_read KEY path
